try:
    numobj = phonenumbers.parse(phone_number_string, default_region)
    is_valid = phonenumbers.is_valid_number(numobj)
    is_possible = phonenumbers.is_possible_number(numobj)
    number_type_enum = phonenumbers.number_type(numobj)
    region_code = phonenumbers.region_code_for_number(numobj)
    e164_format = phonenumbers.format_number(numobj, PhoneNumberFormat.E164)
    international_format = phonenumbers.format_number(numobj, PhoneNumberFormat.INTERNATIONAL)
    
    # Convert enum to string
    number_type_str = str(number_type_enum.name) if hasattr(number_type_enum, 'name') else str(number_type_enum)
    
    return {
        "is_valid": is_valid,
        "is_possible": is_possible,
        "number_type": number_type_str,
        "region_code": region_code,
        "e164_format": e164_format,
        "international_format": international_format,
        "boolean_display": f"Valid: {is_valid}, Type: {number_type_str}, Region: {region_code}",
        "error": None,
        "error_type": None
    }
except phonenumbers.NumberParseException as e:
    return {
        "is_valid": False,
        "is_possible": False,
        "number_type": "UNKNOWN",
        "region_code": None,
        "e164_format": None,
        "international_format": None,
        "boolean_display": None,
        "error": str(e),
        "error_type": e.type if hasattr(e, 'type') else "PARSE_ERROR"
    }
